thesis: A minimal MRP environment tracks tasks, episodes, representations, interpreters, evidence, incidents and library changes.
role: Make the proposed architecture implementable and attributable.

ideas.statement: A minimal MRP environment tracks tasks, episodes, representations, interpreters, evidence, incidents and library changes.
ideas.recurrenceCandidate: Make the proposed architecture implementable and attributable.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A cryptographic identity detects artifact change; the epistemic register distinguishes exact calculation from incomplete-observation estimates.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: The environment is not an existing product; uniform interfaces do not imply uniform trust and names do not establish component value.

audit.notes: Source-grounded analysis; proposed mechanisms and limited guarantees preserved.
